why_not: Most of my guests call or write in WhatsApp, they will not book on a website, and I already got burned once when staff dropped an app within a month. The hostess has her notebook and Direct, I do not want one more thing to check.
У нас уже есть iiko и Kaspi, а брони я сама веду в WhatsApp и Директе, и так всё работает. Зачем мне ещё одна система, которую учить хостес?

I don't know this company, and I'm not putting my guests' phone numbers on some unknown site just because the first month is free. WhatsApp already works for us, and I'd have to talk to the owner anyway.
Мои банкеты и тои держатся на предоплате и на личных звонках, а тетрадь хостес меня пока не подводила. Не хочу отдавать номера гостей какому-то незнакомому сайту.

Мой главный убыток это гости, которые бронируют и не приходят, а тут просто кнопка напоминания, которую хостес ещё должна не забыть нажать. Тетрадь у меня бесплатная, а 9 900 в месяц за то, что не решает неявки, я платить не буду.

My problem is guests who book and then don't come, and a book with a reminder button still leaves me or the hostess pressing it. Everything already comes to me in WhatsApp and Instagram and I answer it myself, so I don't see why I'd move it into another app.
My notebook costs nothing and the hostess already knows it. I cancel anything that doesn't pay off fast, and I can't see how 9 900 tenge a month brings me more money than it takes.
why_yes: Free month, no contract, and I can keep the notebook next to it for two weeks, so I lose nothing by trying. Phone support on Friday and Saturday night is the only reason I would even listen, and the banquet deposits in one place would help me.

Free month, free setup and I can keep the notebook next to it for two weeks, so I risk nothing but an hour of my time. Phone support on Friday and Saturday evening answers my main worry. I would still need the owner to say yes.
